claim.claim-text: 1. A method performed by a user equipment, LTE, in a communication system, the method comprising:
2. The method of claim 1,

wherein the measurement gap sharing scheme information is applied for frequency range 1, FR1, FR2, or the UE, and wherein the value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information is one of 00, 01, 10, and 11 corresponding to a measurement gap sharing scheme.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the type of the DC configured for the UE is one of new radio, NR, radio access - evolved-universal terrestrial radio access, E-UTRA, DC or NR-NR DC.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein, in case that the NR-E-UTRA DC is configured for the UE, the first measurement object is a frequency range 1, FR1, intra-frequency measurement object.

5. The method of claim 1, wherein intra-frequency measurement is performed without a measurement gap based on an identification that a synchronization signal block, SSB, is completely contained in an active bandwidth part, BWP, of the UE.
6. A method performed by a base station in a communication system, the method comprising:

generating a radio resource control, RRC, message including a measurement gap sharing configuration; and transmitting, to a user equipment, UE, the RRC message, wherein the measurement gap sharing configuration includes measurement gap sharing scheme information, wherein a value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information and a type of dual connectivity, DC, configured for the UE are used to identify a first measurement gap sharing ratio allocated to a first measurement object and a second measurement gap sharing ratio allocated to a second measurement object, and wherein the first measurement gap sharing ratio is used to determine a first scaling factor for the first measurement object and the second measurement gap sharing ratio is used to determine a second scaling factor for the second measurement object.
7. The method of claim 6,

wherein the measurement gap sharing scheme information is applied for frequency range 1, FR1, FR2, or the UE, and wherein the value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information is one of 00, 01, 10, and 11 corresponding to a measurement gap sharing scheme.
8. The method of claim 6,

wherein the type of the DC configured for the UE is one of new radio, NR, radio access - evolved-universal terrestrial radio access, E-UTRA, DC or NR-NR DC, and wherein, in case that the NR-E-UTRA DC is configured for the UE, the first measurement object is a frequency range 1, FR1, intra-frequency measurement object.
9. A user equipment, LTE, in a communication system, the LTE comprising:
a transceiver; and a controller coupled with the transceiver and configured to:

receive, from a base station, a radio resource control, RRC, message including a measurement gap sharing configuration, wherein the measurement gap sharing configuration includes measurement gap sharing scheme information, identify a first measurement gap sharing ratio allocated to a first measurement object and a second measurement gap sharing ratio allocated to a second measurement object based on a type of dual connectivity, DC, configured for the UE and a value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information, and determine a first scaling factor for the first measurement object based on the first measurement gap sharing ratio and a second scaling factor for the second measurement object based on the second measurement gap sharing ratio.
10. The LTE of claim 9,

wherein the measurement gap sharing scheme information is applied for frequency range 1, FR1, FR2, or the UE, and wherein the value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information is one of 00, 01, 10, and 11 corresponding to a measurement gap sharing scheme.
11. The LTE of claim 9,

wherein the type of the DC configured for the UE is one of new radio, NR, radio access - evolved-universal terrestrial radio access, E-UTRA, DC or NR-NR DC, and wherein, in case that the NR-E-UTRA DC is configured for the UE, the first measurement object is a frequency range 1, FR1, intra-frequency measurement object.

12. The LTE of claim 9, wherein intra-frequency measurement is performed without a measurement gap based on an identification that a synchronization signal block, SSB, is completely contained in an active bandwidth part, BWP, of the UE.
13. A base station in a communication system, the base station comprising:
a transceiver; and a controller coupled with the transceiver and configured to:

generate a radio resource control, RRC, message including a measurement gap sharing configuration, and transmit, to a user equipment, UE, the RRC message, wherein the measurement gap sharing configuration includes measurement gap sharing scheme information, wherein a value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information and a type of dual connectivity, DC, configured for the UE are used to identify a first measurement gap sharing ratio allocated to a first measurement object and a second measurement gap sharing ratio allocated to a second measurement object, and wherein the first measurement gap sharing ratio is used to determine a first scaling factor for the first measurement object and the second measurement gap sharing ratio is used to determine a second scaling factor for the second measurement object.
14. The base station of claim 13,

wherein the measurement gap sharing scheme information is applied for frequency range 1, FR1, FR2, or the UE, and wherein the value indicated by the measurement gap sharing scheme information is one of 00, 01, 10, and 11 corresponding to a measurement gap sharing scheme.

15. The base station of claim 13, wherein the type of the DC configured for the UE is one of new radio, NR, radio access - evolved-universal terrestrial radio access, E-UTRA, DC or NR-NR DC, and wherein, in case that the NR-E-UTRA DC is configured for the UE, the first measurement object is a frequency range 1, FR1, intra-frequency measurement object.
